docs.title: Lots, Serials, Expiry Dates, Multi-Step Routes, and Landed Costs

sections.text: <!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 -->
Advanced warehouses require batch and serial traceability, shelf-life monitoring, multi-location putaway rules, and accurate landed-cost capitalization for freight and customs duties.

1. Open **Inventory → More → Configuration → Settings** (requires Inventory Administrator / Settings Administration access). 2. Enable the warehouse capabilities you need: * **Company-wide lot tracking** (Traceability): Unlocks **Products → Lots/Serial Numbers** and lot/serial entry on transfers. * **Packages**: Unlocks **Products → Packages** and **Configuration → Package Types** for pallet and carton handling. * **Multiple locations**: Unlocks **Configuration → Locations**, **Storage Categories**, and **Putaway Rules**. * **Advanced routes**: Unlocks **Configuration → Routes** and **Rules** for multi-step receiving, delivery, and Make-to-Order (MTO) flows. 3. Click **Save** and reload the page so the newly unlocked configuration menus appear under **Inventory → Products** and **Inventory → More → Configuration**. ![Inventory Settings toggles unlock Lot & Serial Traceability, Packages, Multiple Locations, Advanced Routes, and Valuation controls.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/inventory-settings.webp)

1. **Enable Tracking on a Product**: Open a storable product → **Inventory** tab → set **Traceability** to **By Lots** (batch quantity) or **By Unique Serial Number** (one unit per serial). For perishable or regulated goods, enable **Expiration Date** and set the shelf-life duration (for example, 365 days). 2. **Receive with Lot & Expiration**: * Open an incoming Receipt (**Inventory → Operations → Receipts**) and switch to the **Detailed Operations** tab. * Enter or select the **Lot/Serial Number** (for example, LOT-UM-QA-01), verify the auto-calculated **Expiration Date**, enter the received **Quantity**, and click **Validate**. 3. **Audit Lot Inventory**: Open **Inventory → Products → Lots/Serial Numbers** to view every active lot/serial, its current location, on-hand quantity, and expiration/alert dates. Outbound deliveries reserve tracked stock automatically using FIFO/removal strategies. ![Lots and Serial Numbers lists every tracked batch alongside its product, on-hand stock, and expiration dates.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/lots-serials.webp) ![Detailed Operations on a validated receipt captures the exact Lot/Serial Number and Expiration Date for every received line.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/receipt-lot-expiry.webp)

Under **Inventory → More → Configuration**: * **Locations**: Define physical storage zones (such as Receiving Dock, Cold Storage, Aisle A, Packing Zone) as child locations under your warehouse stock location. * **Storage Categories & Putaway Rules**: Restrict maximum weight or package capacity per storage category and automatically direct incoming products to their optimal bin/aisle on arrival. * **Routes & Rules**: Configure pull and push rules across locations (for example, *Buy*, *Replenish on Order (MTO)*, or multi-step *Input → Quality → Stock* and *Pick → Pack → Ship*). ![Routes define how products move between suppliers, warehouse zones, and customers.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/routes-config.webp)

When inbound freight, insurance, or customs duties must be capitalized into inventory cost rather than expensed immediately: 1. Ensure the incoming stock Receipt is validated (**Done**) and that you have a service product configured as a Landed Cost service (for example, *Inbound Freight & Customs*). 2. Open **Inventory → Operations → Landed Costs** and click **New**. 3. Fill the header (**Date**, **Account Journal**, and **Transfers** selecting one or more validated incoming receipts). 4. On the **Additional Costs** tab, add each cost line with **Product**, **Description**, **Account**, **Split Method** (*Equal*, *By Quantity*, *By Current Cost*, *By Weight*, or *By Volume*), and **Cost** amount (for example, $100.00). 5. Click **Compute** and switch to the **Valuation Adjustments** tab to verify each product's **Former Cost**, **Additional Landed Cost**, and **New Cost** (for example, $500.00 + $100.00 = $600.00). 6. Click **Validate**. The Landed Cost moves to **Posted** and adjusts inventory valuation accordingly. ![A posted Landed Cost shows the exact Former Cost, Additional Landed Cost, and New Cost breakdown under Valuation Adjustments.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/landed-cost-valuation.webp)

* **Lot/Serial Field Missing on Transfers**: Confirm **Company-wide lot tracking** is enabled in **Inventory Settings** and that the product's **Traceability** is set to *By Lots* or *By Unique Serial Number*. * **Landed Cost Valuation Adjustments Empty**: Ensure the linked Transfer is in **Done** status and contains storable products before clicking **Compute**. * **Stock Valuation Report Requires Published Cost State**: If **Reporting → Stock Valuation** reports an unpublished cost state on a stock line, ensure product standard/average costs are published and accounted for before re-opening the report.

docs.title: Warehouse Operations, Cycle Counts, Scrap, and Replenishment

sections.text: <!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 -->

The **Inventory** application gives warehouse operators real-time visibility into incoming receipts, outgoing customer deliveries, stock counts, damaged-goods scrap, and automated replenishment. ![The Inventory Overview groups daily warehouse queues by operation type—Receiving, Deliveries, and custom operations—with live To Process, Waiting, Late, and Backorder counters.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/overview-dashboard.webp)

* **Inventory User**: Processes receipts, deliveries, stock counts, scrap orders, and views stock reports. * **Inventory Administrator**: Configures Inventory Settings, Operation Types, Locations, Routes, Rules, Putaway Rules, Storage Categories, Package Types, Quality Control Points, and Landed Costs. * **Replenishment (Buy Route)**: Generating draft RFQs from reordering rules requires the **Purchase Stock** addon and Purchase User access.

1. Open **Inventory** to view the **Overview** dashboard. 2. Click **To Process** on any operation type card (such as **Receiving** or **Deliveries**), or open **Inventory → Operations → Receipts / Deliveries / All Transfers**. 3. Open a transfer in **Ready** status and review: * **Operations** tab: Planned products, initial demand, and units of measure. * **Detailed Operations** tab: Move lines showing source/destination locations, lot/serial numbers, expiration dates, and done quantities. 4. Click **Validate** once quantities are verified to transition the transfer to **Done** and update warehouse on-hand quants immediately.

1. On an open receipt in **Ready** status, switch to **Detailed Operations** and enter the actual quantity physically received (for example, 8 units out of 10 demanded). 2. Click **Validate**. 3. Depending on the operation type's **Create Backorder** setting: * **Ask**: Choose **Create Backorder** to generate a linked open transfer for the remaining 2 units, or **Close Remaining Demand** if no balance will arrive. * **Always**: Automatically creates the backorder transfer without prompting. * **Never**: Closes the transfer at the received count with no backorder.

1. Open **Inventory → Operations → Record Stock Count** (recommended cycle-count workflow) to adjust stock quantities cleanly: * Select the **Location**, **Product**, optional **Lot/Serial Number**, and **Counted Quantity**. * Enter a descriptive **Adjustment Note** (for example, Monthly Cycle Count) and apply the count. 2. Open **Inventory → Operations → Physical Inventory** to inspect updated **On Hand**, **Reserved**, and **Available** quantities per location and lot. ![Physical Inventory displays live On Hand, Reserved, and Available quantities per product, warehouse location, and lot.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/physical-inventory.webp)

1. Open **Inventory → Operations → Scrap** and click **New**. 2. Choose the **Product**, verify the **Unit** of measure, enter the **Quantity** to scrap, and select the **Lot/Serial Number** (for tracked products) and source/scrap locations. 3. Click **Validate** to move the scrapped quantity out of sellable stock into the virtual Scrap location.

1. Open **Inventory → Operations → Replenishment** (or **More → Configuration → Replenishment**). 2. Review or create a reordering rule specifying **Product**, **Location**, **Min Quantity**, **Max Quantity**, and the **Buy** route (make sure the product has an active Vendor Pricelist). 3. Click **Request Quotation** (or let scheduled replenishment evaluate forecasted stock): * When forecasted stock (on-hand + incoming − outgoing) drops below **Min Quantity**, ERPForAll drafts a Request for Quotation for the quantity required to restore stock to **Max Quantity**. * If forecasted stock is already at or above **Min Quantity**, ERPForAll avoids unnecessary duplicate RFQs unless you specify a manual override quantity.

Open **Inventory → More → Reporting** to audit inventory balances and movement history: * **Stock**: Read-only quant list showing **On Hand**, **Reserved**, and **Available** per location and lot. * **Stock Report / Product Stock Position**: Hierarchical stock view grouped by warehouse zone and product. * **Moves History**: Complete audit log of every stock move line with date, reference, product, lot/serial, source/destination locations, quantity, and status. * **Moves Analysis & Returns**: Operational pivot/graph analytics and dedicated return transfer tracking. ![Moves History logs every validated receipt, delivery, cycle count, and scrap movement with full location and lot traceability.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/inventory/moves-history.webp)

* **Negative Stock Refused on Validation**: If a storage location forbids negative stock and insufficient free stock exists, ERPForAll halts **Validate** without moving stock. Adjust done quantities to available free stock or validate pending incoming receipts first. * **Physical Inventory Inline Apply Error**: If applying a count directly from an individual quant form fails, use **Inventory → Operations → Record Stock Count** to apply the cycle count cleanly and verify the updated On Hand count in **Physical Inventory**. * **Missing Unit on Scrap**: Always confirm the **Unit** field is populated on a new Scrap order before clicking **Validate**.

In Inventory, open the supplier receipt and check the company, destination and received quantities. When Stock Valuation Admission is installed, a stock manager validates receipts of company-owned storable products into an internal or transit location of the same company. Select the receipt's company among your active companies. Validation records the physical receipt and reserves its company/product control for the transaction. The control carries no price.

For an access refusal, ask a stock manager with access to the company and the transfer to validate it. If a valuation seal or a competing operation prevents completion, refresh the transfer and check its state before retrying. A seal that continues to block receipts needs administrator attention. If an integration submits several pickings in one transaction, send the full batch in one validation so the system can reserve every affected product before moving stock. If validation reports too many receipt sources, split the receipt batch into smaller operations. Repeated lines for the same product also count toward this limit. An administrator can adjust the bounded source-row limit in Technical System Parameters.
